title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2 — Media, Evidence and Public Trust
prompt: In many countries, people now get most of their news from social media platforms rather than from newspapers or broadcasters, and stories often spread before anyone has checked them. Some people argue that platforms should be legally required to remove unverified claims quickly, while others believe that open debate, even when it includes doubtful information, is the better way to protect the public. Discuss both views and give your own opinion on which approach is more likely to help citizens judge what is true. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有情境与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先明确题目要求你讨论的两种观点（平台应被法律要求快速删除未经核实的信息 / 开放讨论更有利于公众判断真相），再给出你自己的立场。写作时请做到：引言清楚改写题目并表明立场；主体段落分别展开双方理由，并说明各自的前提与局限；用具体但虚构的例子支持论点，不要编造官方统计数据；结论重申你的判断。全文不少于250词，注意段落衔接与论证逻辑，不要只罗列观点。
